test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T)/(100)

**Calculation:**

SI = (2000 × 7 × 2)/(100)

⇒ SI = (28000)/(100)

⇒ SI = 280

**The simple interest is ₹280.**
